summary: Every cmd/vloop top-level test calls t.Parallel() (none stayed serial). TestWorkedExampleB6RealData clones HEAD and now compares the real repository's HEAD, all refs and each .git/hooks file's content before and after the run, tolerating working-tree edits.
verified: vloop task gate T1 exited 0 and printed ok; go test -count=1 ./cmd/vloop/ passed.
notes: The parallel changes were done in earlier attempts; this attempt added the hooks comparison actually present in the file (sha256 per hook) with the imports it needs. .git/config is deliberately not compared (editors rewrite it during runs). Tracked working-tree files cannot be compared since they legitimately change; refs, HEAD and hooks are what the run could write through the clone's origin.
